comments.body: Is the date of this correct (otherwise issue opened after meeting date if I see correctly)?
@holgerd77, that is correct. There was no issue, so i thought to add it. So we can track progress.

> @holgerd77, that is correct. There was no issue, so i thought to add it. So we can track progress.

Ah, ok, thanks!

Short question if you have time to answer, what was the outcome from the call on this: "adding available block range into eth protocol handshake"?

Will this be added and in what form?

I was a bit afraid when reading this that this might lead to the habit of clients to just drop peers with not-useful (so: in a unidirectional sense) block ranges? And this might therefore have some potential to derail the peering experience for clients just starting to sync? 🤔 Or will there be something added like "clients must not drop the peer connection depending on the available block range of the other peer" or similar?
@holgerd77 honestly I am still drafting the EIP. But this is a valid concern. i think the draft will be discussed next call. Please chime in.

@fjl @lightclient
I think we can discuss this draft as part of next breakout meeting agenda:
https://hackmd.io/@smartprogrammer/rkqC8y42n
cc, @holgerd77
